The acceleration in M3 growth relates to the reduction of
the state's cash reserves deposited with the Bank of Greece to
refinance the public debt and the rise in forex reserves due to
capital inflows from abroad and the high EU transfers, it said.
M4 money supply grew provisionally 11.7 percent year-on-year
